notes.title: Slayaway Camp 2 is AVAILABLE NOW!
notes.content:
Dear Fellow Slashers,

We all miss Friday the 13th: Killer Puzzle very much (props to those of you who have shown their support and are still playing—we hope you treasure it forever!)

We wanted to let you all know your other favorite cute n' murdery buddy Skullface is back with HUNDREDS of EPIC MURDER PUZZLES - brought to you by the same diabolical developers that made F13. Slayaway Camp 2 just released on Steam with tons of puzzles, new minigames, different killer types (each with their own mechanics), and a new "Endless" mode you can play to compete for the top slasher spot on the Steam Leaderboards.

Slayaway Camp 2 is available now (with a launch discount of 13% for the first 13 days — ending November 10!)

With plenty of campers ready to be murdered, we hope you'll give it a try!

notes.title: Friday the 13th: Killer Puzzle - Winding Down
notes.content:
Hello Friday the 13th Fans,

Today we have to make a sad announcement: We were unable to renew the license for Friday the 13th: Killer Puzzle with the licensors and have been required to wind down all future sales of the game later this month.

[b]We have been assured by all platforms that players who have already downloaded / purchased the game and made in-app purchases within the game will continue to have access to the content they paid for in perpetuity.[/b] [i](So please grab it while you can!!!)[/i] The game will be coming down from the storefronts across all platforms on January 23rd, 2023.

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and disappointment this causes. It is a truly sad situation and all of us at Blue Wizard are absolutely crushed as well—F13: Killer Puzzle is a game we are [i]so[/i] incredibly proud of.

Thank you for your support over the years, and stay tuned to [url=https://www.bluewizard.com]BlueWizard.com[/url] for future updates. Also don’t forget we still proudly offer the the Overwhelmingly Positive rated Horror-Puzzle game that started it all: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/530390/Slayaway_Camp/]Slayaway Camp[/url]!

For updates on if anything changes with Friday the 13th: Killer Puzzle, please sign up to our official mailing list at www.f13killerpuzzle.com

Sincerely,
Blue Wizard Digital

notes.content:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/895800/Friday_the_13th_Killer_Puzzle__Official_Soundtrack/

Thanks again to everyone who has helped make Friday the 13th: Killer Puzzle such a success. Mother is pleased. :MrsV:

notes.title: F13KP Patch Notes - v1.6.4
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32204839/141c0c7d2e4698c39a3425aec81d069146494994.gif[/img]

Hey Slayers! We've had an incredible launch week and already have over [b]2 MILLION PLAYERS[/b] slashing their way through Camp Crystal Lake and beyond! We've updated the game on Steam with a new version that includes a handful of bug fixes and optimizations. Feel free to get in touch (support@bluewizard.com) if you notice anything strange while you're running the game and we can be sure it gets dealt with as quickly as possible in a future update!

Here's a quick rundown on what you can find in the 1.6.4 Patch:
[list]
[*] Found those missing DLC Jason weapons -- [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/795100/discussions/1/1696045708641004861/]check here for info on restoring them[/url]
[*] Resolved a save game issue
[*] Tidied up some visual content & bugs
[*] Fixed the Lucky Number 13 achievement
[*] Squashed some bugs involving puzzle solutions
[*] Fixed a bug where rewinding caused music to stop playing
[*] Fixed several minor ui bugs
[*] Fixed bug with Steam Controller Support -- should now be functional!
[/list]

Thanks so much for making this an incredible launch for us! Your positive feedback and excitement has been keeping us going strong. Thank you so much for the kind and thoughtful reviews — keep em coming!!

Cheers,
The Blue Wizards :slayawayknife:

notes.title: The time is right for a bit of Friday the 13th: Killer Puzzle
notes.content:
It’s the second-spookiest day of the year, so let’s cap off the week with a little murder. Friday the 13th: Killer Puzzle is a light, silly, mostly-free and utterly gore-drenched spinoff from Blue Wizard Digital’s Slayaway Camp, a simple block-sliding puzzle dressed up as a slasher horror splatter-rampage. This time, you get to play as everyone’s favourite ultra-zombie, Jason Voorhees. He’s a good boy, really – listens to everything his mum tells him.
